choices.text: no, I  actually, my name isn't Elias

barista_correction.speaker: Barista
lines: It's the regulars, you know. Half of you blur together by the third coffee.

effects.journal: The barista called me Elias today. I corrected him. He apologised, said the regulars blur together. I didn't tell him what my name actually is. I'm not sure I remember.

barista_apology.speaker: Barista
lines: Right. Coffee, no sugar. On the house today, sorry about that.

barista_too_much.speaker: Alex
lines: (He's already turned to the machine. I don't think he heard. Or he did, and chose not to.)

onExit.journal: I told him he calls me Elias every morning. He didn't answer. The line moved. Someone behind me was already ordering.
